title: DCR reviewer output
description: Structured output a /dcr reviewer agent returns for one review wave. One lens report per lens the agent ran.

lens.description: Name of the review lens, for example Security or Frontend Design.

status.description: PASS when the lens found no issue that must be fixed.

findings.description: Issues this lens found. Empty when the status is PASS.

what_looks_good.description: Short notes about the parts of the change that are correct.

severity.description: CRITICAL blocks the change. MEDIUM must be fixed soon. LOW is optional.

title.description: One short sentence that states the defect.

file.description: Path of the file that contains the defect, relative to the repository root.

line_start.description: First line of the defect. Lines start at 1.

line_end.description: Last line of the defect. Lines start at 1.

trigger.description: The concrete input, state, or call path that produces the failure.

why.description: Why the code fails for that trigger.

confidence.description: How sure the reviewer is that the finding is real, from 0 to 1.
